title: Add prominent start button as primary call-to-action

requirements.summary: Add a large, prominent 'Start Coaching Session' button to the CoachingDashboard component that appears above the existing quick-start coaching topic cards, serving as a primary call-to-action for authenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: A visually prominent button labeled 'Start Coaching Session' or similar is visible on the coaching dashboard
The button appears in a strategic position (e.g., hero section, above quick-start cards) to draw user attention
Clicking the button initiates a new coaching session flow (e.g., opens topic selection or starts a general coaching session)
The button complements rather than replaces the existing quick-start coaching topic cards
Button styling aligns with the existing design system (theme colors, animations, accessibility)

file_operations.description: Add a prominent 'Start Coaching Session' button in a hero section above the existing quick-start coaching topic cards. The button should use the existing OKLCH-based color system (theme colors from index.css), include appropriate hover/focus states, and be visually distinct from the topic cards. Position it prominently at the top of the dashboard content area. When clicked, the button should navigate to a general coaching session or present topic selection. Ensure the button complements the existing quick-start cards and maintains the current dashboard layout structure. Use shadcn/ui Button component for consistency with the existing design system.
